items.title: 52263_Sonny Greer oral history interview
items.q: This was Duke, this is Sterling Conway and me. That's all.

ctx.x: and when you first -- and when you and Ellington and Hardwicke first began to get together, now, like for instance, in this the early twenties, picture we have here which is from / and at Louis Thomas. band You have it, three-member/ here with Sterling -- I mean was everybody here in the band?
Yeah, this was the band -- these were the singers. This was Duke, this is Sterling Conway and me. That's all.
This is page 31 of Music Is My Mistress. Now, when did Elmer Snowden and the other people come into the group?
